name: ai-engineering-skills
description: A framework-agnostic skills and agents marketplace for the whole AI-assisted engineering lifecycle: idea to spec to issues, design review before code, test-first build, review with a design pass, PR, CI, merge gates, release and incident. Backend, mobile and web.

plugins.name: lifecycle
plugins.description: The whole delivery lifecycle as gated skills: idea, MVP scope, project bootstrap, feature investigation, spec, issues, design review before code, test-first implementation, pre-commit, PR, CI, deploy check, merge gates, release, observe, incident, postmortem, cleanup. Framework-agnostic.

plugins.name: quality
plugins.description: Testing doctrine, TDD, writing tests, code review with a separate design pass, security and privacy review, accessibility audit, performance checks and privacy-safe product analytics. Framework-agnostic, with stack references.

plugins.name: backend
plugins.description: Backend conventions (layers, ports and adapters, one home per technical kind of code, allowlist architecture tests), contract-first endpoints, safe schema migrations and read-only data checks. References for .NET, Django, Node and Spring.

plugins.name: mobile
plugins.description: Mobile app architecture, a shared cross-platform core, background work and battery, an offline queue that never loses data, permissions, screens from designs, home-screen widgets and real-device testing. References for Flutter, React Native, Kotlin, Swift and Kotlin Multiplatform.

plugins.name: web
plugins.description: Web front-end conventions (pages, components, tokens, zero-JS by default, CSP, privacy, accessibility, performance budgets) and adding a page test-first. References for React/Next.js and Astro.

plugins.name: agents
plugins.description: Independent subagents: architect (design review of a plan before any code), reviewer (cold code review with a design pass), tester (fills test gaps, failure paths first).

plugins.name: meta
plugins.description: Keep the workflow improving: create or update skills with a fresh-agent dry run, record architecture decisions, and turn a lesson from a real project into a skill change.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Opt-in hooks: block a commit that adds something that looks like a secret, and block commits made directly on the main branch.
